style_en: 白い何もない空間に置いたミニチュアの模型（ジオラマ）の3DCG。人物は顔の細かい所が無い、つるんとしたフィギュア。色は白と灰色が中心で、大事な物だけ赤

cuts.image: 白い台の上に、赤い封筒と2枚の白い券
cuts.image_en: a single open red envelope lying on a small white pedestal in the middle of the frame, two plain blank white tickets with no text sliding out of it, a soft spotlight on it
cuts.en: a single open red envelope lying on a small white pedestal in the middle of the frame, two plain blank white tickets with no text sliding out of it, a soft spotlight on it

cuts.image: 白い空間に、白い柱の大きな建物と並木の街のジオラマ
cuts.image_en: a small winter city diorama with plain white government-style buildings with columns and bare trees in the middle of the frame, no flags, no signs, no text
cuts.en: a small winter city diorama with plain white government-style buildings with columns and bare trees in the middle of the frame, no flags, no signs, no text

cuts.image: 小さな家の模型が何十軒も並び、どの郵便受けにも赤い封筒
cuts.image_en: dozens of tiny plain house models in neat rows in the middle of the frame, each with a small plain mailbox holding a single red envelope, no text
cuts.en: dozens of tiny plain house models in neat rows in the middle of the frame, each with a small plain mailbox holding a single red envelope, no text

cuts.image: 赤い封筒を開いて喜ぶ男のフィギュア
cuts.image_en: a faceless man figurine in a plain gray sweatshirt and jeans stands in the lower-middle of the frame holding an opened red envelope and two blank white tickets up high, his whole posture excited, empty white space above his head
cuts.en: a faceless man figurine in a plain gray sweatshirt and jeans stands in the lower-middle of the frame holding an opened red envelope and two blank white tickets up high, his whole posture excited, empty white space above his head

cuts.image: 白い空間に、小さなアメフトの競技場の模型（ロゴ・文字なし）
cuts.image_en: a small plain American football stadium model in the middle of the frame, green field with plain white lines, empty stands, no logos, no team colors, no text, soft light
cuts.en: a small plain American football stadium model in the middle of the frame, green field with plain white lines, empty stands, no logos, no team colors, no text, soft light

cuts.image: 空っぽの小さなオフィスに、電話だけが置かれている
cuts.image_en: a tiny empty office room diorama in the middle of the frame: a bare desk with only a plain old telephone on it, empty chair, blank walls, no text
cuts.en: a tiny empty office room diorama in the middle of the frame: a bare desk with only a plain old telephone on it, empty chair, blank walls, no text

cuts.image: 会場の模型に、蝶ネクタイの案内係・チアリーダー・鳥の着ぐるみのフィギュア
cuts.image_en: a small convention hall diorama in the middle of the frame with round brunch tables: faceless figurines of ushers in black tuxedos, cheerleaders in plain red-and-white outfits with no letters, and one big plain yellow bird mascot costume stand around smiling-postured, all placed low with empty space above

cuts.image: 会場のテーブルの客のフィギュアを、案内係たちが囲む

cuts.en: the same small convention hall diorama in the middle of the frame: seated faceless guest figurines in casual clothes at round tables are suddenly surrounded by the faceless ushers in black tuxedos, who stand close behind each chair; the bird mascot stands at the back; tense moment, figures placed low with empty space above
